verses.1: Tyre and Sidon and all their borders belong to the land of Judah, those who exalt themselves. Now woe to them, when I seize them in my wrath, for they shall be diminished and punished.
verses.2: The Lord says: Because there has gone forth from them a proud and arrogant one, a son of perdition, an adversary of righteousness, who stiffens his neck and is haughty and does not know his Maker; for he showed me my enemy, that I might show my power over him, says the Lord who rules over all.
verses.3: This is their end: Samaria and Galilee and Syria and Damascus and Cyprus and Achaea and all the region of the Jordan, peoples stiff of neck, who walk in their stubbornness, who have covered themselves with darkness and the shadow of death, and who are not established in the fear of the Lord, who have hardened their heart like a stone and do not obey that proud one.
verses.4: Woe to them then, to those who obey the unclean ones and offer sacrifices in their names, for they have transgressed against the Lord who created them, and they have become like beasts that have no understanding; for that wicked one, the son of perdition, sets up his image in every place, and rejoices in the work of his hands and in the desire of his soul, and in all filth and fornication and iniquity and corruption, and in all the adultery and fornication and falsehood that he commits.
verses.5: For in his days he knows how to act thus, for it was given him by the Lord to do this.
verses.6: The sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall become blood, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and every work shall be made desolate, with wonders that shall come in the last days, that he may repay the earth and all that is in it according to the works of the hands of those who dwell in it.
verses.7: And at the last, death shall rule over the adversary, for he exalted himself above the creation of the Lord and did as he pleased for one hour.
verses.8: And after that there shall be no more boasting, for I will repay, says the Lord who rules over all.
verses.9: And he shall descend into torments and into the fire that is prepared for him on the day when he is seized in my wrath; for he draws all who are with him into perdition and into torments and into the fire, for I am he who brings out and brings into the fire of Gehenna.
verses.10: Let not the mighty man boast in his might, for it is he who gives strength and power to the weak, and again he gives weakness to the strong and the mighty.
verses.11: And you shall be saved by the word of the mighty ones and by the calves of the dead, for he is the one who seizes and repays those who are driven out from the hand of their oppressors.
verses.12: Woe to you who are haughty and stiffen your neck, and it seems to you that I will not seize you and repay you in my wrath, as he said to the soul and the righteousness: O star of the morning from heaven, which rises at the time of dawn.
verses.13: For he said in his pride and in his arrogance: I will set my throne above the heavens and the stars, and I will be like the Most High.
verses.14: This you have done in your pride, and you did not remember the Lord who created you and made you with his hands. Why have you exalted yourself, that you should descend to the depths below in the hardness of your heart?
verses.15: And in your pride you were brought lower than all the angels who are like you, for they glorify him in humility of spirit to their Creator, and they do not transgress his command, for they know that it is he who made them and created them, and they kept their understanding so as not to transgress or depart from his command.
verses.16: But you did evil in the pride of your heart, and you became more wicked than your fellows; for you were the chief of all iniquity and filth and corruption and fornication, which the sinners who are like you commit, and the wicked who came from your creation and transgressed like you, and who walk in all your will and your command which you taught them wickedly.
verses.17: Woe to you and to those whom you have led astray; in your rebellion you shall descend together into the fire.
verses.18: And you children of the Lord who have gone astray through that deceiver who leads astray, woe to you; together you shall descend into torments for ever, for thus you have gone astray through him whom you loved, him and his demons.
verses.19: And as for the former things, while Moses the servant of the Lord was alive, you provoked him at Horeb and at the water of Temptation and at Mount Sinai and at Amalek.
verses.20: And again, when I sent you seven springs into the land of inheritance, and when they said to you, 'Their way is far and their cities are strong, reaching up to heaven, and their fortresses are great, and those who are greater than you dwell and live there,' and when they said this to you, you rejected and forsook the word of the Lord, so that you turned back to the land of Egypt in your wicked counsel.
verses.21: And you did not remember the Lord who saved you from your affliction, who did great things in Egypt and led you by the hand of his angel, so that the sun did not burn you, a cloud by day, and so that your feet did not stumble in the darkness, giving you light by night with a pillar of fire.
verses.22: And when Pharaoh and his army frightened you and pursued you, you cried out to Moses, and Moses cried out and called to the Lord, and by his angel he separated you, so that you were not found together with the army of Pharaoh.
verses.23: But them he brought into affliction, for the Lord says: He alone led them, and there was no strange god with them; and their enemies he covered in the sea in the deep, and no survivor was left among them.
verses.24: And Israel passed through on foot in the midst of the sea, and nothing and no one of the Egyptians found them, and he brought them to Mount Sinai, and there he fed them manna for forty years.
verses.25: And they feigned their worship of the Lord, while he did good things for them; for they always provoked the Lord, as it is written in the book of the generation of the fathers, and he said: Their heart is stubborn toward the calves of the living one, and all their works are in fornication, and they do evil continually, and there is none among them who desires righteousness, except one who gathers wealth by iniquity and swears by falsehood, and injustice and oppression and theft and fornication.
verses.26: And in this evil they persist all the days of their life, and the children of Israel have exceedingly provoked the Lord, transgressing the commandments of the Lord from the beginning even to the end.
